mechanism: Lattice point = in-page arena offset of every anchor = (IP low byte A2h) - 16*(1000h - FAR_SEG). Bytes: A 0029 'B0 A2' (mov al,A2h) + A 004A '81 CA FB 0F' (or dx,0FFBh); B 0031/0077 'B0 A2' + B 0096 '81 CA FB 0F'. FAR_SEG 0FFBh -> in-page 52h for A, B and captured zombies. Steps 4400h/2C00h are multiples of 100h so the in-page offset never changes. AL cannot be changed (pushed IP low byte A4 = MOVSB rebuild trigger), so FAR_SEG is the only knob; each -1 in FAR_SEG lowers the lattice by 10h.
counters: rev0 clones differing only in FAR_SEG: lat_p00 (0FFBh, identical to base, control), lat_m10 (0FFAh, 42h), lat_m30 (0FF8h, 22h), lat_m50 (0FF6h, 02h), lat_p10 (0FFCh, 62h), lat_m60 (0FF5h, BROKEN: page-00 IP wraps below the arena), lat_x1005 (01005h, F2h; trail CS word 05 10 instead of FB 0F, less lethal).

candidates.label: lat_m30 (FAR_SEG 0FF8h both warriors)
candidates.change: or dx,0FFBh -> or dx,0FF8h in A and B (lattice 52h -> 22h; also applies to captured zombies)

Base (52h) undercuts a clone 10h above (62h, Chimera/m050 lattice)

recommendation: Do not promote lat_m30 (FF8). Mechanism verified in rev0. Lattice shifting is a field-composition bet, not a fix: it moves the hole, and the FF8 shift cost -0.026 on the 2025 group and lost to zchain4.
